entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I need to return something. My VeloBand.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, it's Alex Miller, order number 788-B45.

Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor purchased on December 15th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
I... I think it's a fault? The pulse part just gives me weird numbers. I think this whole thing is just garbage. I really don't have time for this.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. I'd be happy to walk you through a few quick troubleshooting steps. It might just be a simple calibration issue we can fix right now.
No, I just... I can't. It's too complicated and I don't have time to be a technician. Can't you just help me? I just want my money back for a refund.
I understand completely. You'd prefer to return it without troubleshooting. Let me just check the return policy for your order. One moment please.

Alright, Alex, thank you for waiting. I've reviewed your account. It looks like the delivery date was December 15th, and our policy states that you have 90 days to return an item. You are well within that window.
Oh! You can do it? I was so confused by the website. That's a huge relief.

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print that out, place the VeloBand back in its original packaging, and drop it off at the post office. Once our warehouse receives it, we'll process your full refund.
Wow, okay. That's much easier than I thought. Thank you so much, Charlie.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
